lines.text: God tells Israel to be holy, to respect their mother and father, and not to make molten gods.
A peace offering may be eaten on the day of sacrifice or the next day; leftovers on day three burn.
Israel must leave the edges of the field and the fallen grapes for the priests.
God tells Israel to rebuke a neighbor directly, seek no revenge or grudge, and love their neighbor as themselves.
Fruit from new trees is forbidden for seven years, offered in praise in year four, and eaten in year five.
